_: Kill-check for asc-09wx.12's treatment arm. The handler is a YAML predicate, so the mutants are the two things that decide WHEN the sentence arrives and it loads at all: the predicate it matches on, and the tool it is narrowed to. A third mutant on `on:` was measured and discarded: changing the kind fails the file at COLLECTION, because the describe block loads the handler at module scope, and a mutant that will not load proves nothing about any test. Killers were found by applying each mutant and reading the failing names off assertionResults.
